title: Scaffold Vite project with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui
active_form: Scaffolding Vite project with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui
description:
Initialize a new Vite project with React and TypeScript at apps/todo/. Configure Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling and initialize shadcn/ui with the components needed by the app: toast, input, button, and checkbox. Set up Vitest and React Testing Library for the test suite. Ensure the dev server runs successfully and TypeScript compiles without errors.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Sections 7.2, 9.1

functional: Vite project initialized at apps/todo/ with React and TypeScript
Tailwind CSS configured and utility classes render correctly
shadcn/ui initialized with toast, input, button, and checkbox components
Vitest and React Testing Library configured and a smoke test passes
Dev server starts successfully with npm run dev

testing_requirements.target: Dev server starts and renders default page
